exposure: Type of healthcare setting (public vs. private)
cohort: Pregnant women delivering at a tertiary care hospital between 2012 and 2017
finding: The CS rate was significantly higher in private compared to public practice, and non-elective CS rates were significantly lower during nighttime compared to daytime.
mod_finding: The Cesarean section rate was significantly higher in private practice compared to public practice (59.2% and 30.4% respectively).
